arguments.description: Check oleans and build logs for relevant files
arguments.command: $files = @('S1894D5LargeImageActual','S1942PrePsiFiveActual','S1933PrePsiSeparableActual','S1924ZeroCriterionActual','S1906RankTwoTorsionActual','S1725SourceTorsionFPrimeActual'); foreach ($f in $files) { $o = ".lake\build\lib\lean\tmp\sheaf\xif\paper\$f.olean"; if (Test-Path $o) { $i = Get-Item $o; "{0} : {1} bytes, {2}" -f $f, $i.Length, $i.LastWriteTime } else { "$f : MISSING" } }

data.label: $files = @('S1894D5LargeImageActual','S1942PrePsiFiveActual','S1933PrePsiSeparableActual','S1924ZeroCriterionActual','S1906RankTwoTorsionActual','S1725SourceTorsionFPrimeActual'); foreach ($f in $files) { $o = ".lake\build\lib\lean\tmp\sheaf\xif\paper\$f.olean"; if (Test-Path $o) { $i = Get-Item $o; "{0} : {1} bytes, {2}" -f $f, $i.Length, $i.LastWriteTime } else { "$f : MISSING" } }
